verdict.rationale: Loops exposes a broad REST API/SDKs/CLI/MCP covering contacts, events, transactional email, workflows, and content (LMX) creation, giving strong API parity for most core UI actions (loops-docs-3,4,7,23,24,27,26). However, the docs explicitly state campaigns can only be drafted via API and must be 'reviewed and sent from the dashboard' (loops-docs-5), showing a concrete gap where UI-only action remains required. missing for 10: full API-driven campaign send (not just draft), and independent/hands-on confirmation that API truly mirrors every UI capability.
